title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: Accessibility features were updated to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA compliance, enhancing user experience for compliant users.
backbase_rationale: Compliance updates do not affect the existing integration functionality.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK’s minimum supported Android API level has been increased from 23 to 24, potentially breaking existing applications that target lower API levels.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its integration to target Android API 24 or higher to remain compatible with the new SDK.

backbase_rationale: The delay affects only SMS delivery to Liberty network in Puerto Rico, with no immediate impact on Backbase services.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Twilio SendGrid removed the Send to Coworker action from the Domain Authentication flow, simplifying DNS record management.
backbase_rationale: Reduce risk of DNS configuration errors by removing low-usage action.

title: Verify tightens fraud prevention geo permissions for Italy and Argentina

backbase_rationale: Ensure compliance with updated fraud prevention posture.
